label: Constellation field
desc: Particle networks in four styles: drifting linked nodes, a parallax star sky, a springy lattice and orbiting hubs; the pointer pulls or pushes the nodes.
use: Behind a landing hero, footer or sign-in panel (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Predictive arc
desc: Five generative Canvas 2D scenes selected by variant: a pixel-grid horizon arch, pulses on a signal network, flowing ribbons, a halftone dot matrix and flow-field trails.
use: Behind a product or analytics hero (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Portal field
desc: Ambient particle fields: a rotating noise-shaped cloud, a resonant plate whose grains settle on nodal lines, and streams converging on a focal portal that follows the pointer.
use: Behind a hero or call-to-action band (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Spark badge
desc: A luminous credential badge assembled from particles that spring home, scatter from the pointer and shed embers on curl-noise currents.
use: Hero visual for a membership, certificate or sign-up page (fills its positioned parent; the badge is centred).

label: Elemental fields
desc: Four generative fields in one component: rippling water, branching lightning, rising fire and beading condensation on glass.
use: Behind a hero, feature band or empty state (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Laser field
desc: Pointer-reactive laser beams in a WebGL shader with three layouts: a fan from the floor, a vanishing-point grid and a prism that splits one beam into a spectrum.
use: Behind a hero or event page (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Liquid form
desc: A ray-marched metallic liquid blob of smoothly merging spheres with a reflective sky; the pointer drags a lobe around.
use: Hero accent or loading visual (centred in its parent, which it fills).

label: CRT screen
desc: A curved-glass CRT shader (barrel curvature, scanlines, aperture mask, bloom, flicker) showing a terminal, a test pattern, static or an arcade title screen chosen by the screen prop.
use: Behind a retro or developer-tools hero, 404 page or terminal-style section (fills its parent).

label: Network globe
desc: A dotted globe of nodes and arcs with FBM atmosphere glow; drag to spin with inertia, arrow keys rotate, pulses travel along the arcs.
use: Hero visual for infrastructure, network or global-reach pages (fills its parent; the globe fits the smaller side).
